title: Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Charges Matrix
content:
Claims Payments uses this matrix to show which rental charges each Cardinal Rental Reimbursement option pays. "Paid" means the option pays the charge; "Not paid" means it does not.

## Agency charges

| Charge | 30/900 | 40/1200 | 50/1500 | 60/1800 | 75/2250 | 100/3000 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Agency loss or collision damage waiver | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid |
| Fuel or refueling charges | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid |
| Per-mile charges | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid |
| One-way drop fee | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid |
| Fee for delivering or collecting the rental car | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Paid | Paid | Paid |
| Under-25 renter fee | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid |
| Additional driver fee | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Paid |
| Child safety seat rental | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Paid | Paid |
| GPS units, toll transponders and similar add-ons | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid |
| Agency counter deposit | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid | Not paid |

## Transportation other than a rental car

| Term | 30/900 | 40/1200 | 50/1500 | 60/1800 | 75/2250 | 100/3000 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rideshare, taxi and public transit fares paid instead of a rental car | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Each fare needs a trip receipt | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## Damage to the rental car

| Term | 30/900 | 40/1200 | 50/1500 | 60/1800 | 75/2250 | 100/3000 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| The vehicle's own physical damage extends to damage to the rental car | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

Column headings are the options of Cardinal Rental Reimbursement by daily limit and per-loss maximum (for example, 60/1800 is Cardinal Rental Reimbursement 60/1800).

## Reading across a row (hypothetical)

- The same $15.00 delivery fee is paid on 60/1800, 75/2250 and 100/3000. It is not paid on 30/900, 40/1200 or 50/1500.
- An additional driver fee is paid only on 100/3000. A child safety seat is paid on 75/2250 and 100/3000.
- No option pays fuel, so a refueling charge is not paid whichever option the vehicle carries.
